punchline: Before Lippmann made his bet, he got rival banks to agree on the contract.
thirty_sec: In early 2005 Deutsche Bank trader Greg Lippmann held a dinner with men from Goldman, Bear Stearns, Citi and JPMorgan; a standardized subprime CDS came out of it, and by autumn he was betting heavily on a housing fall.
question: Which people or teams must you agree a rule with before your idea can work?
key_contrast: An idea alone is not enough; it needs a shared rule.
